title: xpute manifest
description: A program's manifest: the memory, fixed ranges, heap, stacks, stream and GPU its core asks for. xpute-gen writes it into both ends.

gen.description: Where a file's code goes, each from this file's directory: its TypeScript (a protocol's enums in a folder named as it is, beside it) and its Rust (a manifest's constants, which the core's build script also includes as it links).

bytes.description: The core's memory, whole before its first entry and never grown: the stack, the module's data, the fixed ranges and the heap.

fixed_bytes.description: The program's fixed ranges, past the module's data and before the heap, never freed.

min_heap_bytes.description: The heap the core counts on, past the fixed ranges.

module_bytes.description: A module's stack, first in the memory.

thread_bytes.description: A native core's thread's stack, outside the memory.

stream.description: A stream the core writes records into and something beside it runs.

gpu.description: What the core asks of its GPU, read by the GPU plugin.

features.description: WebGPU's feature names. The surface's format is the platform's, and the limits the adapter's.

optional.description: What it takes where the adapter has it.
